data.desc: Founded in 1988, SuperCom (NASDAQ: SPCB) is a global provider of IoT, cybersecurity, and digital identity solutions for governments and enterprises worldwide. SuperCom's IoT solutions combine proprietary wearable devices, communications technology, and monitoring software to deliver real-time electronic monitoring for public safety. Its PureSecurity suite, including the PureOne GPS monitoring solution and the PureProtect domestic violence monitoring solution, is deployed in government programs across Europe and North America. Through its wholly owned cybersecurity subsidiary Safend, SuperCom provides endpoint data protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and device and port control solutions, helping organizations protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized data access and transfer. SuperCom has also introduced SafeGenie, a suite for the real-time monitoring and control of AI agents.
